title: select_intent
description: SELECT_INTENT decoder contract (R58 verdict §2). The allowed values for 'intent' are NOT enumerated here — they are a short DYNAMIC allowlist the harness supplies at runtime (playbook ids currently loaded, plus the always-legal escape value 'unknown'). This schema only shapes the envelope: a lowercase snake_case intent name plus evidence-handle citations, never raw prose.

intent.description: One playbook id from the harness's current dynamic allowlist, or 'unknown'.

support.description: Observation-store evidence handles, never inline prose claims. May be empty only when intent == 'unknown'.
